sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 610. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies (NPCs). Decreases action speed by 60 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Cost recovery speed reduced by 10 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 90 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Disaster Collapse (reduces action speed by 30, reduces Cost recovery speed by 10, extends cooldown times by 30%, and reduces status ailment resistance by 30) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000

[Martial Artist] Tao or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
